dict.string: Keep needs access to your photos to securely store them in your vault.

Keep uses the camera only when you choose to take a new photo to import into your encrypted vault—for example, to photograph a document, receipt, or ID you want stored as a vault file. Photos you take are saved only where you save them in Keep and are not used for advertising.
Keep needs access to your files to securely store them in your vault.
Keep uses Face ID to securely unlock your vault and protect your encrypted files.
